rows.text: Such statements include statements containing forward-looking words such as “expect,” “anticipate,” “aim,” “estimate,” and variations thereof, including without limitation statements, whether direct or implied, regarding expectations of that for the fourth quarter of 2026, we expect revenue to be approximately $550 million plus or minus 3%; we expect non-GAAP gross margin to be 37.0%, plus or minus 1%; and non-GAAP adjusted EPS to be $1.35, plus or minus $0.10.
These expected result drives us closer toward our three year financial goals of $2 billion in annual revenue and over $4 in non-GAAP EPS.
